observations.body: Thanksgiving and steadfastness answer deception. But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth, comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

payload.posture: Read 2 Thessalonians 2:13–17 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states thanksgiving and steadfastness answer deception. But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth, comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
